title: Keys on the Hook
story: Every evening Nora hangs her keys on the hook by the door. Last night she left them in her coat pocket. In the morning she searched the table, the sofa, and her bag. Her sister found the keys and held them up. Nora thanked her and put the keys on the hook. She set a note on the door so she would remember tomorrow.

A small bag sewn into clothing.
A long soft seat for two or more people.
To keep something in your mind.
